subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — stakeholder checklist & timeline options
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@harborhealth.org>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — stakeholder checklist & timeline options

Hi Elena and Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion on performance targets and procurement constraints. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that crystallizes the milestones, owners, and key dependencies we discussed. High level summary below so nothing gets lost in the spreadsheet: 

- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for clinical summarization pipeline (100k tokens/day) with production-ready SLA by Q2 pilot close.
- Proposed target-close windows (pick one):
  • Option A — Accelerated: pilot sign-off by 2027-03-31 (2-week tech validation; procurement quick turnaround)
  • Option B — Standard: pilot sign-off by 2027-04-21 (recommended if procurement needs extra review)
- Initial milestones (in MAP tab):
  1) Technical validation (runbook + sample workload) — Owner: Redwood SE (Marissa) + Medsys Dev (Jordan) — due 2 weeks after kickoff
  2) Compliance clearance (SOC2 evidence + DPA) — Owner: Medsys Procurement (Jordan) + Redwood Legal — dependency: medsys procurement SLA
  3) Pilot rollout (subset of tenants, monitoring) — Owner: Medsys Eng Lead (TBD) + Redwood Ops (Marissa)
  4) Commercial sign-off & contract finalization — Owner: Medsys Procurement + Redwood AE

Dependencies called out in the sheet: SOC2 report, IP/DP flow diagram, and sample dataset access. I noted the documents you said you would request from internal Legal/InfoSec — added as action items.

Asks: 
1) Please confirm the primary and backup stakeholders we should list for each milestone (I put Jordan as procurement contact and left Medsys Eng Lead blank).
2) Which timeline option do you prefer (A or B)?
3) Any dependencies we missed (security questionnaires, procurement windows, travel restrictions)?

Next step: if you confirm stakeholders and pick a timeline, I'll lock the MAP and propose 2x 45-min kickoff slots next week to align owners and triage blockers.

Attachments: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (workbook), discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), pricing-worksheet.csv (baseline figures).

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@harborhealth.org>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — stakeholder checklist & timeline options

Thanks Lauren — useful draft, and appreciate the clear milestones. A few quick items from our side: 

- Stakeholders: Please list the following for Medsys: Jordan Price (Procurement) — jordan.price@medsys.com; Elena Ruiz (IT Ops / project sponsor) — elena.ruiz@harborhealth.org; Rafael Mendes (Platform Lead) — rafael.mendes@medsys.com. I'll confirm Rafael's availability tomorrow.
- Timeline: we can't commit to Option A due to an internal procurement freeze that lifts 2 weeks later. Can we aim for Option B (2027-04-21)?
- Dependencies: we will need a completed SOC 2 Type II report and network diagram for our Security review. Also can you confirm data retention/default retention settings for the pilot?
- Milestone change request: remove the 'travel-led on-site run' milestone — we'll do remote validation only for this pilot.

If you can update the MAP sheet with the stakeholder names and Option B, we'll block time for the kickoff. Also, Jordan — looping you to align on procurement questions (I called out the docs in the sheet).

Thanks Elena — noted and thanks for the quick clarifications. I updated MAP_v0.1.xlsx with stakeholder names and set target to Option B (pilot sign-off 2027-04-21). Key updates: 

- Stakeholders added: Jordan Price (Procurement), Elena Ruiz (Project Sponsor), Rafael Mendes (Platform Lead).
- Removed on-site travel milestone and replaced with 'remote runbook execution' owned by Marissa + Rafael.
- Dependency table: added SOC2 Type II checkbox and a request for network diagram + sample data schema.
- Data retention: default pilot retention set to 30 days (configurable). I've called out an action item for Redwood Ops to confirm retention SLAs for PII — Marissa is preparing a short doc (will attach once ready).

Next steps: 
1) Proposed MAP kickoff (45 min) — please pick one: 
   • Wed, 24 Feb 2027, 10:00–10:45 PT
   • Thu, 25 Feb 2027, 14:00–14:45 PT
2) Jordan — can you confirm procurement's typical review window so we can set realistic gating dates?
3) Marissa — I cc'd you to prepare the tech validation plan + sample workload steps (low-friction remote run).

I'll upload the updated workbook to the Drive link and share a HubSpot update after you confirm.

Attachments: updated MAP_v0.1.xlsx (stakeholders/timeline updated).
